name: Nerest Client
changelog_title: Nerest 1.8.27: Mining loop fix, AutoFirework crash fix & ShaderHands FL 10_1
changelog: Fixed Regen & OreMiner infinite mining restart loop by restoring target lock, eye height, and network break packets.
Fixed fatal crash in AutoFirework by replacing actor->getFlag with actor->getStatusFlag(ActorFlags::Gliding).
Fixed ShaderHands on Feature Level 10_1 GPUs by targeting vs_4_1 and ps_4_1 shaders.
